title: Machan Story Page
request: Oct 19 2026 16:10 ICT: Max asked 'prepare fresh new decks on the same topics i swiped on. they don't have to be as long. i like 10 at a time.'
example_data: Story page mockups: short video of Machan's journey (surviving and learning) then a carousel; kawaii but powerful; wish glyph as a highlight; lore only: the Chinese wish pun, the Korean tiger tale, Greek Diospyros, the Ozark seed, the Nagasaki tree.
no_cap: Max asked for 10 at a time (Oct 19 2026)
